resolutions: Pinned planning commit 829500087 as the task hydration source and protected the immutable reference hash and untouched archive branch.
Expanded the acceptance contract to name the complete browser, lifecycle, model, provider, approver, verification, migration, visual, and handoff behavior.
Added shared model-credentials, model-provider preflight, provider-conversation discovery, outbound projection, and message carrier paths to task ownership.
Required onboarding runId in outbound send metadata and durable projection with exact account, conversation, canonical thread, code, inbound, outbound, and run correlation.
Protected auto, anthropic_sdk, and deepagents plus provider compatibility and pre-spawn failure behavior.
Required deterministic live provider selection, supported-only Slack preselection, Teams setup-only behavior, and non-empty discovery.
Corrected direct messages to derive the counterpart automatically while groups use recognized installer or validated manual membership.
Bound channel tokens to runtime-owned gantry-secret references with existing direct, env:, and aws-sm: modes and typed policy-disabled refusal.
Expanded focused required tests across all named negative transitions and durable lifecycle states.
Classified onboarding endpoints as same-origin browser facades with their repository envelope and an explicit x-gantry-browser-auth OpenAPI extension.
Replaced invalid citations with the repository's actual modularity, logging, exception, API, database, and provider standards.
Required UUID row identifiers and actor plus timestamp audit fields for onboarding lifecycle tables.
Required generation from a clean baseline, a clean migration directory afterward, and the migration-journal unit test.
Protected current main package metadata and exact Node >=24 <25 range.
Added agent-runtime, channel-interactions, credential-management, and web-ui-foundation documentation to task ownership.
Required splitting the route and workspace implementation at splash, shell, model, workspace, assignment, and verification responsibility boundaries below 300 lines.
The user adopted the complete amended task contract and confirmed no task-grill finding remains open.
current_flow: Current main has the secure browser-session boundary, provider registry, model preflight, provider-conversation discovery ports, outbound message projection, desired-state authority, and public OpenAPI owner, but no V2 onboarding product flow. The pinned archive adds the user-facing and persistence delta but persists credentials before verification, can accept empty discovery, lacks exact run projection correlation, and carries obsolete migration history. The amended task reuses current-main seams, imports only the pinned product delta, and closes those defects before persistence or Console handoff.

criteria_map.The task worktree hydrates decisions 016: Task-start proof records the generated worktree base; git show copies only the four governing documents from 829500087; shasum asserts the reference hash; branch SHA checks prove the archive tip is unchanged.
criteria_map.The splash and all four onboarding steps: The hashed reference drives Playwright Core and browser-Canvas comparison at every named viewport with loaded local fonts, frozen named frames, saved/system motion variants, and only the visual-contract masks.
criteria_map.The same-origin browser onboarding facad: Focused browser route and OpenAPI tests exercise every auth rejection and header plus response, log, audit, and error redaction; the route docs carry x-gantry-browser-auth rather than Bearer security.
criteria_map.The focused onboarding application servi: Application and disposable-Postgres tests assert one transaction, unique app ownership, stored request fingerprints/results, replay equality/conflict, service identity, desired-state/audit writes, and step-specific invalidation.
criteria_map.Model setup accepts only the exact agent: Focused core tests spy on preflight-before-repository order, all exact harness values and incompatibilities, healthy replacement preservation, and model gating; web tests assert loading/lock and secret-state clearing.
criteria_map.Channel setup stores only runtime-owned: Channel credential and onboarding tests assert stored references only, reference-mode selection, policy refusal, absence from agent projection/browser responses, and zero-conversation incompletion.
criteria_map.Provider selection is deterministic from: Provider catalog, browser, and Postgres tests cover ordering/fallback, supported-only Slack default, Teams no-connect path, Agent ownership, service alias, DM derivation, and both valid/invalid group membership paths.
criteria_map.The verification challenge persists acco: Disposable-Postgres and projection tests assert each correlation field and negative transition, inspect runId through send options and durable message rows, then fail/retry projection without reopening the challenge.
criteria_map.Exactly one generator-produced current-s: The generator creates one SQL/snapshot/journal delta from current schema; migration-journal and schema-isolated pgvector tests assert shape and lifecycle; a second generation followed by git diff --exit-code proves cleanliness.
criteria_map.The adopted web implementation preserves: Diff review asserts the exact engine range and shared primitives; architecture/lint checks plus line-count review verify route/page ownership boundaries rather than cosmetic file splitting.
criteria_map.Focused browser, model, provider, lifecy: Every named behavior is mapped to a protected required-test title in the decomposition or to the focused suite commands in the task plan; fresh JUnit output is recorded through Forge.
criteria_map.Lint, formatting, type checks, web and r: Forge verify records the deterministic commands and JUnit evidence; the direct autoreview helper records quality/performance/security plus animation review; the functional check records listener/logs and all three local endpoints before stopping without push or PR.
